items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Terminology 35:1
items.html: MAN [female waters] means it causes a coupling. It is always the aspect of NHY or ZON. For the Nukva is corrected by the posterior light of Ima, which is attached only to the light of Hassadim and repels Hochma. Therefore she does not turn her face to the male to receive the illumination of Hochma, unless she has some cause that compels her to do so. This cause is the aspect of ZON, to whom Bina has a connection, to illuminate him with the illumination of Hochma, by virtue of the relation of Bina and ZON in direct light. Therefore, when ZON rises to her as MAN, she immediately stops her posterior and turns her face to Hochma, to receive from him the illumination of Hochma. Thus she couples with him face to face. (Item 39, and Inner Light, Sub Header, “The Fourth Degree”)
